cp.title: Campaigns
cp.sub: Each push you run: who it is for, the offer, the creative, when it runs and the budget you plan. Orders carry the landing page they came from.
cp.planNote: The budget here is your plan. Nothing on this page changes a budget on Facebook, Google or TikTok, and nothing is ever raised by itself.
cp.emptySub: Make one for each push: the audience, the offer, the creative, the window and the budget you plan.
cp.name: Name
cp.objectiveHelp: Delivered purchases first: a refused parcel is not a sale.
cp.audienceEmpty: No audiences yet. The Audience Builder makes them from real orders.
cp.offerSub: A coupon or your own words. Prices and discounts are never set here.
cp.couponHelp: The coupon's own rules and limits apply.
cp.creativeSub: The ad's words. Photos and videos stay in the creative studio.
cp.headline: Headline
cp.whenSub: When it runs and what you plan to spend.
cp.budgetHelp: A plan only. Leave empty for none.
cp.budgetLocked: Locked once the campaign has started. A change to a live budget goes to the owner for approval.
cp.pagesSub: Pages that name this campaign. Their orders count here.
cp.pagesNone: No landing page names this campaign yet.

stepAsk.end: End it — it cannot run again

cp.readOnly: You can see this campaign but not change it.

err.STALE: Someone changed this campaign meanwhile. It was read again — check and save once more.
err.BUDGET_LOCKED: The budget is locked once the campaign has started.
err.NEEDS_START: Set a start time in the future first.
err.WRONG_STATE: That step does not fit the campaign's state now.
err.ARCHIVED: Restore the campaign before changing it.
err.budget: Type the budget as a number, like 800.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
